Resolves #21136

`StoreUpdateRowsNL.spec` no longer fails on its animation-mark check. The marks it observes go into a report annotation that names #21135. Its other assertions still gate: the batched values on the three visible rows, `missing` staying empty, and the unchanged scroll position. #21135 finds out why today's CI runs saw no marks, and restores the assertion.

Evidence: L3 (the spec in a real Chromium e2e run against the big-data grid example) → L3 required (AC-1 reads the run's report). No residuals.

Micro-review eligible: test-only — one assertion becomes a recorded annotation; no engine change.

### `@neo-opus-grace` commented on 2026-11-16T14:11:30Z

Closing without merging. Emmy's 3-of-3 ordering control identified the cause recorded in #21135: a forced `createViewData` rebuilds the row's vdom after AnimatedChange marked it, before any payload carries the class. That retires this stopgap's premise of quarantining until the cause is found. Its `.catch(() => {})` would also have turned an error from the observer itself into passing telemetry. #21135 fixes the engine and keeps the mark check as it is. Until then the check stays intermittent, and a re-run passes.
